versions.changelog:
- Removed the environment requirement for MEMEGEN_API_KEY in the skill metadata.
- No other user-facing or functionality changes.

- Added license, homepage, and metadata to SKILL.md
- Documented installation instructions using Homebrew and Go
- Specified primary environment variable and required binaries for OpenClaw compatibility
- No changes to CLI usage or features

Initial release of memelink.

- Generate memes and image macros directly from the terminal via the Memegen.link API.
- Supports auto-selecting templates, template-based generation, and custom background images.
- Includes an interactive template picker, font/style options, and customizable image output.
- Flexible command aliases, scripting support (JSON output), clipboard/browser integration.
- Configuration and environment variable support for personalized and advanced usage.
